summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature (rich.progress open/wrap_file, Progress.open/wrap_file, private _ProgressReader and _ReaderContext) across rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py (20 new tests), docs/source/progress.rst, and CHANGELOG.md. Nothing committed; tests, mypy, and repo code were not run, so everything is verified by reading only. Open risks: Progress.open's overloads may cause a call-overload mypy error where the module-level open passes a str mode, and wrap_file's context-wrapper return may need the same return-value suppression that open has. Choices made: byte-count column is DownloadColumn; reads on a closed reader raise ValueError; write raises io.UnsupportedOperation naming 'write'.
